subject: Skill Graph metadata and manifest consistency auditing

evals.prompt: Define graph-audit in the Skill Graph context in 2-3 sentences. Include SKILL.md schema checks, audit-state sidecar checks, manifest joins, and relation-target integrity.
expected_elements: Checks SKILL.md against the live Skill Metadata Protocol schema
Checks audit-state.json sidecars for loop-owned state
Checks manifest output as a joined view of SKILL.md plus sidecar state
Checks relation targets point at real sibling skills
Treats metadata drift as a skill-library quality issue

evals.prompt: Explain the mental model for why graph-audit exists. Why is silent metadata drift worse than a loud failure?
expected_elements: Skill retrieval can be subtly wrong when metadata or relation edges drift
A broken relation or stale enum may not crash the agent
Graph-audit turns silent graph bugs into visible lint or audit findings
It protects routing, manifest consumers, and per-skill audit evidence

evals.prompt: Distinguish graph-audit from skill-infrastructure, skill-router, refactor, debugging, and testing-strategy. Give mechanism-level boundaries.
expected_elements: skill-infrastructure owns designing or maintaining the health tooling
skill-router owns choosing between skills for an incoming request
refactor owns changing skill body structure
debugging owns root-cause analysis of runtime failures
testing-strategy owns choosing test levels and regression coverage
graph-audit owns applying consistency checks to skill artifacts

evals.prompt: A teammate says, 'The manifest generated, so relation integrity is fine.' Explain the misconception using graph-audit.
expected_elements: Manifest generation alone is not the whole audit
Relation targets must be checked against real sibling skill directories
Sidecar-owned audit state must not be duplicated or stale in SKILL.md
Eval/verdict claims require matching gradeable artifacts
Graph-audit needs multiple checks, not one successful generator run

evals.prompt: A project-targeted skill has deployment_target: project but no grounding truth_sources, and it also has a relations.verify_with target that does not exist. Apply graph-audit and name the findings and required fixes.
expected_elements: Flags missing or incomplete project grounding
Flags dangling relation target
Requires adding real truth_sources or changing deployment_target if project grounding is false
Requires replacing or removing the missing relation target
Requires re-running lint or the graph-audit verification checks
